text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
That vaunted name has given us
countless
legends who made their mark
on the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, Mejiro Ryan...

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer, and many more.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Their running is still fresh in the minds of
fans,
who continue to be drawn to them.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Today, we look back on the history of
the Mejiro
family, featuring footage from
never-before-seen
interviews.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Fans have been eagerly awaiting the rise
of a new
Mejiro racer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, my journey with Mejiro Dober to
take on
the Twinkle Series begins!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's going to need to work harder than
ever if
she's to become the rising star the
world is
anticipating.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go to the training course to look for
Mejiro
Dober, and when I get there...
choice_data_list: まずは今後の相談をしにいこう！
choice_data_list_en: First, let's go talk about our next steps!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Should be all warmed up now.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! It's Mejiro Dober! She's as cool as
ever! ♪

text_block_list.name: Younger Student B
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't expect anything less from a
Mejiro.
They just have this aura about
them...

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for her debut race. I bet it's
gonna be
awesome! I wanna go watch it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is attracting attention from
the
younger students. It looks like
expectations are
high within the
academy as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, having this many eyes on her might
make her
nervous. I have to do
something before she gets
unnerved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer?! Don't just suddenly shout my
name!
And it's not like I was waiting for
you...
choice_data_list_en: Sorry to keep you waiting, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. No worries, I just got here.
choice_data_list: 人目も多いし、まずは場所を変えようか
人目も多いし、まずは場所を変えようか
choice_data_list_en: There are too many eyes here, so let's move somewhere else first.
There are too many eyes here, so let's move somewhere else first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...O-okay.
choice_data_list: 人目も多いし、まずは場所を変えようか
人目も多いし、まずは場所を変えようか
choice_data_list_en: There are too many eyes here, so let's move somewhere else first.
There are too many eyes here, so let's move somewhere else first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Sure. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once we're away from the crowd, I tell
her I want
to talk about plans for her
debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once we're away from the crowd, I tell
her I want
to talk about plans for her
debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, before we start... You were trying
to help
me back there, weren't you?
...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping me back there. I was
honestly
feeling kind of flustered, so I
appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Actually, your timing works out. I
wanted to talk
to you about my debut as
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Actually, your timing works out. I
wanted to talk
to you about my debut as
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to run properly, to
become a
racer strong enough to run
with confidence at all
times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And I want to start by putting everything
I've got
into my debut race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'm just stating the obvious. I wasn't
fishing for
compliments.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-is it? All I did was state the obvious.
You don't
have to flatter me, you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, um, I just wanted to make my
intentions
clear, so... Let's make it
happen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, um, I just wanted to make my
intentions
clear, so... Let's make it
happen.
choice_data_list: 俺からも、改めてよろしく！
私からも、改めてよろしく！
choice_data_list_en: Looking forward to working together again, from me too!
Looking forward to working with you again from me, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sure. Anyway, about my training...
choice_data_list: 俺からも、改めてよろしく！
私からも、改めてよろしく！
choice_data_list_en: Looking forward to working together again, from me too!
Looking forward to working with you again from me, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Same here. Anyway, about my training...
Dober!
Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff! I've been looking all over for you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bright, a ladylike and laid-back peer of
Dober's
and a fellow Mejiro, runs up to
us, waving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: There's a—eep!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student B
text_block_list.text:
That clumsy side of her just makes me
wanna
protect her! It's so adorable!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text:
I totally understand. I kinda feel bad,
but seeing
her like this brings a smile to
my face...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear. My legs seem to have gotten
all
tangled up. This is no good. No good
at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Everyone seems to be
looking at
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Good day, everyone! It's another
wonderful day
for training, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! Bright!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright carries herself with a
self-possessed
calm as she addresses the
younger students.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Some things never change...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, Dober. Apologies for
interrupting your
training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
G-greetings. We haven't actually started
yet, so
it's no bother. Was there
something you wanted
to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Since we're in the same year, I thought
I'd come
to give my salutations and
cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As racers of the Mejiro family, let us
forge
through the Twinkle Series
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Let's work hard together,
Bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Motivated by Bright's words, Mejiro
Dober seems
more determined. I have to
take advantage of
this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What? Now? I'm sure Bright has her own

training—
choice_data_list: せっかくだから併走してみないか？
せっかくだから併走してみない？
choice_data_list_en: Since we're both here, want to run side by side?
Since we're both here, want to run side by side?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a fabulous idea. I've
already finished
warming up, so why
don't we start right away?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, of course. I love running with you,
Dober.
That said...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Don't think I'll allow you to take the
lead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, unfortunately for you, I
don't plan on
letting you run ahead of
me either!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff! Puff! Huff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two sprint off under the clear sky,
their every
step filled with drive. It's
clear how much
motivation they derive
from each other.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! They're really going at it!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student B
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see how they do after
their debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! They look like they're having
loads of fun!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Seems they're well prepared for their
debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Hehe. I didn't expect anything less from you, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whew... You did great too, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can tell Mejiro Dober and Mejiro Bright
are
going to become great rivals for
each other!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's keep it up going into our debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right. I'll work hard so I can run at my
absolute
best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I resolve to work hard too in order to
make her
powerful words come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus begin my days of fighting alongside
Mejiro
Dober!
